enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Shift legs. Turn again. Pull blanket up. Lie still. Breathe steadily. Occasional slight movements.
Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Turn on shower. Wash body. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Turn off light.

Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take out bread. Put bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Take out bowl. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Eat cereal. Eat toast. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on light. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Turn off light. Leave bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock front door. Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Check patient list. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check blood pressure. Check temperature. Check heart rate. Record data. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Update chart. Use computer. Attend team meeting. Discuss patient care. Write notes. Wash hands. Take break. Drink water. Return to work.
Walk to cafeteria. Stand in line. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Clear tray. Throw trash. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Wash hands. Enter patient room. Check IV. Adjust IV. Talk to patient. Administer injection. Record data. Update chart. Consult with doctor. Attend training. Use computer. Answer phone. Write prescription. Review lab results. Wash hands. Take break. Drink water. Return to work.

Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait at bus stop. Check phone. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Hold handrail. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock front door. Enter house. Close door.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Put pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Add meat. Cook. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Put dishes in sink. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV, using air conditioning due to heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Sit on bed. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Watch TV. Adjust air conditioner. Lie down. Pull blanket. Watch TV. Change channel. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner. Turn off light. Get into bed.
Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Leave bathroom.
